name: Asher
source: The sensible one among the three Guardian Dragons, Asher’s calm and composed nature serves him well when making Loic and Nero cooperate. Unlike the others, he also treats you with kindness.
translation: The sensible one among the three Guardian Dragons, Asher’s calm and composed nature serves him well when making Loic and Nero cooperate. Unlike the others, he also treats you with kindness.
